items.title: Roche nabs expanded FDA approval for diagnostic tied to Jazz’s cancer drug
items.summary: Roche has been given an extended clearance by the FDA for its tests that can find patients eligible to use Jazz Pharmaceuticals’ oncology med Ziihera.

items.title: Lilly scores Novo-pressuring Mounjaro expansion to curb heart risks in diabetes patients
items.summary: In their high-profile competition in the diabetes and obesity markets, Eli Lilly has proven adept at playing catch-up with Novo Nordisk. On Friday, Lilly checked another item off that list as it secured FDA approval for Mounjaro to reduce the risk of heart attack or stroke in at-risk adults with type 2 diabetes.

items.title: Priovant pushes ex-Pfizer asset across FDA finish line in rare skin and muscle disease
items.summary: Though not without a bump along the way, Roivant-backed Priovant Therapeutics has pushed its dual TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor across the FDA finish line, securing its first approval in a rare skin disease.

items.title: BioNTech-Genentech cancer vax records more deaths than control in scrapped ph. 2 test
items.summary: Following Merck and Moderna’s phase 3 triumph with a Keytruda-paired personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, a similar shot from BioNTech and Genentech has faltered in a reminder of the approach’s struggles as a standalone therapy.

items.title: AusperBio adds $120M series C to advance hep B oligo therapy through phase 3 and beyond
items.summary: AusperBio Therapeutics has raised $120 million in series C funds to advance its oligonucleotide therapy for chronic hepatitis B through phase 3 testing and hopefully on to commercialization.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Vivace revs up C-suite ahead of pivotal push
items.summary: Vivace Therapeutics has named Craig Gibbs, Ph.D., as its new president and CEO.

items.title: Akeso CEO looks beyond lung cancer with biliary tract win, counters ivonescimab debate
items.summary: Fresh off a phase 3 win in biliary tract cancer, Akeso CEO Michelle Xia, Ph.D., is touting the PD-1xVEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab’s ability beyond non-small cell lung cancer, even as she continues to defend the drug’s data against skepticism.

items.title: FDA greenlights Abbott’s wearable sensor for capturing diabetic ketoacidosis
items.summary: The FDA has approved Abbott’s first-of-its-kind bio-wearable sensor that can warn diabetics of increased ketones that can lead to diabetic ketoacidosis.

items.title: ESC: AZ, Ionis' Wainua post-mortem throws water on silencer-plus-stabilizer approach in ATTR-CM
items.summary: After a surprise washout in a recent phase 3 trial of AstraZeneca and Ionis’ antisense oligonucleotide Wainua, the likely reason for the miss is being laid bare, in a potential ill omen for others pursuing silencer drugs in transthyretin-mediated amyloid cardiomyopathy.

items.title: Takeda bolsters blood cancer portfolio with FDA nod for Mimrylo in polycythemia vera
items.summary: The FDA has approved Takeda’s Mimrylo (rusfertide) for polycythemia vera, introducing a new mechanism to the nonmalignant rare blood cancer and handing CEO Julie Kim another major regulatory win since taking the helm.

items.title: Biogen enlists lupus patient advocate to share social media story of resilience
items.summary: Biogen highlighted patient advocate and content creator Naomi Rose’s story living with cutaneous lupus erythematosus (CLE) on its social media platforms.

items.title: Gilead christens Bixlenvo with FDA nod for new HIV treatment combo tablet
items.summary: Some 20 years after helping introduce the first once-daily single-tablet HIV regimen, Gilead Sciences has crossed the regulatory finish line with a new oral treatment option in the U.S.

items.title: Amgen, AZ’s Tezspire lands phase 3 eosinophilic esophagitis win, turning up heat on Dupixent
items.summary: Amgen and AstraZeneca’s inflammatory disease drug Tezspire has clinched a phase 3 win in eosinophilic esophagitis as the partners eye another challenge to Sanofi and Regeneron’s incumbent Dupixent.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: FDA expands nod for HIV med Tivicay to include newborns
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: With Trump's nominee pick in, FDA weighs new deputy commissioner posts: report
items.summary: As the leadership vacuum at the top of the FDA looks poised to close with President Donald Trump’s nominee pick for a replacement commissioner, the agency is reportedly weighing whether to add two new deputy posts under that role.

items.title: Teva saddles up as stalking horse bidder for bankrupt BioXcel’s neuroscience portfolio
items.summary: BioXcel Therapeutics has filed for bankruptcy and lined up a deal for Teva Pharmaceutical to acquire its assets for $57.5 million upfront.

items.title: JATT mastermind launches latest biotech-focused SPAC via $60M IPO
items.summary: Just two months after Someit Sidhu, M.D., succeeded in pairing off his second special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) with Talawar Therapeutics, the biotech entrepreneur is back at it again.

items.title: ESC: Cytokinetics delves deeper on ‘huge’ Myqorzo readout, fueling cardiomyopathy expansion bid
items.summary: Cytokinetics' cardiac myosin inhibitor, Myqorzo, is the first to demonstrate significant, clinically meaningful benefits in patients with a rare heart condition called non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. An approval for this indication could potentially double the pool of patients Myqorzo serves today.

items.title: China in Global Clinical Development: Why Early Inclusion Matters
items.summary: Leading biotechs are rethinking China’s role in global clinical development. Early inclusion can unlock significant value.

items.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: AusperBio adds $120M; Abcuro secures $66M
items.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

items.title: Genentech doubles down on ADC-resistant cancers with $1B DualityBio pact
items.summary: Roche’s Genentech is paying DualityBio $45 million upfront for rights to antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) designed for the growing pool of patients who progress after treatment with the modality. The deal is worth more than $1 billion in potential milestones.

items.title: With mRNA back in the spotlight, tRNA shows potential to treat genetic disease
items.summary: New research coming out of the University of Toronto has shown that transfer RNA may offer a promising therapeutic avenue for treating genetic diseases.

items.title: Research into protein interactions sheds new light on causes of autism
items.summary: Studying protein-protein interactions might hold the key to identifying druggable targets for autism, a group of scientists at the University of California, San Francisco has suggested.

items.title: CEPI backs push to bring Egyptian biotech's Ebola vaccine into clinic to curb fast-growing outbreak
items.summary: The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations has committed up to $16.5 million to push Minapharm’s Bundibugyo vaccine candidate into the clinic, furthering its response to the Ebola outbreak.

items.title: Osivax bags flu vaccine rights to pursue combination shot vision
items.summary: Osivax has licensed an influenza vaccine from GC Biopharma, positioning the biotech to build on early evidence that its midphase candidate complements traditional flu shots.

items.title: After some ‘tough years,’ Frontier’s CEO is ramping up ambitions for precision med platform
items.summary: After announcing the “tough but necessary” decision to lay off some employees last year, Frontier Medicines is looking to the future by advancing more cancer drugs into the clinic while continuing to find partners to leverage its AI proteomic platform.

items.title: Flagship’s ProFound partners with Gates Foundation in $35M preeclampsia target discovery pact
items.summary: Flagship Pioneering’s ProFound Therapeutics is keeping its string of high-profile partnerships going, forging a new pact with the Gates Foundation worth up to $35 million to find new drug targets for a dangerous pregnancy complication.

items.title: Medigen links up with Charles River in push to take enterovirus vaccine global
items.summary: Charles River Laboratories and Taiwan-based Medigen Vaccine Biologics are teaming up to advance Medigen’s multivalent enterovirus vaccine.

items.title: FDA greenlights Revolution Medicines' pancreatic cancer gamechanger
items.summary: Following dynamite data that earned a standing ovation at the American Society of Clinical Oncology meeting in May, Revolution Medicines’ Ras inhibitor daraxonrasib has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of metastatic pancreatic cancer.

items.title: Hansoh heralds China’s move from ‘follower’ to ‘frontrunner’ in biopharma race
items.summary: Hansoh Pharmaceutical has given a bullish assessment of China’s innovative pharma sector, arguing that the industry is “fully transitioning from the ‘follower’ to the ‘frontrunner’ phase.”

items.title: Boston Scientific hit by cyberattack causing ‘disruptions’ to parts of its business
items.summary: This year has seen a growing number of medtechs hit by cyberattacks, and now Boston Scientific has become the latest victim.

items.title: Spyre’s rheumatoid arthritis plan toppled by subpar TL1A data
items.summary: Phase 2 data on Spyre Therapeutics’ anti-TL1A antibody SPY072 in rheumatoid arthritis have fallen short of expectations, prompting the biotech to deprioritize monotherapy development in the indication.

items.title: SK Biopharma pens $795M deal to usher Biohaven’s epilepsy therapy towards hoped-for 2029 launch
items.summary: SK Biopharmaceuticals has strengthened its epilepsy offering by paying $350 million upfront to help speed Biohaven’s Kv7 ion channel activator on its way to market.

items.title: Labcorp launches new hepatitis D test to find patients with most severe form of virus
items.summary: Labcorp is looking to plug the gap in hepatitis D monitoring with a new reflex testing solution to help find more patients with this form of the virus earlier.

items.title: McKesson strikes $2.25B deal to snap up Precision Medicine Group
items.summary: The healthcare conglomerate, which ranks eighth on the Fortune 500 list, is set to envelop privately held Precision Medicine Group into its oncology branch as part of an ongoing effort to grow its high-margin cancer and biopharma businesses.

items.title: MrBeast, Snapchat, AI and more: Pharma marketing’s pulse check
items.summary: In this week’s episode of “The Top Line,” Fierce’s Ben Adams and Zoey Becker discuss how pharma marketing is evolving across social media, creative work and agency strategy.

items.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Lilly's Foundayo scripts cross 40K
items.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

items.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Roche’s $2.5B obesity deal; Akeso CEO’s defense; Lawmaker’s reflection on China
items.summary: Roche is taking a less-trodden path in obesity. Akeso CEO counters concerns over shrinking lung cancer data for ivonescimab. A U.S. congressman says China is "beating us on our ground game" in biotech. Plus more.

items.title: Omnicom PR consultancy injects new leadership into pharma push
items.summary: Omnicom’s maslansky + partners has expanded its leadership team, hiring two new partners and expanding the role of a founding partner to strengthen its healthcare and life sciences practice.

items.title: Stephen Farquhar takes over as CEO of Publicis Health Media
items.summary: Stephen Farquhar has taken over as CEO of Publicis Health Media (PHM), succeeding longtime Publicis executive Andrea Palmer.
